description: Source code for DHCP client control functions related to IPv4 and IPv6, including enabling and disabling DHCP clients, setting parameters, and managing neighbor discovery. The file defines functions for DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 layer operations, uses component management functions, and includes configurations for network interfaces.

methods.name: amxd_status_t dhcpc4_enable(UNUSED mode_ctrl_t mode,const amxc_var_t * const parameters)
methods.description: Enables DHCPv4 client on specified interface by setting interface parameters and activating the DHCPv4 component.

methods.name: amxd_status_t dhcpc4_disable(UNUSED mode_ctrl_t mode,const amxc_var_t * const parameters)
methods.description: Disables DHCPv4 client on specified interface by deactivating the DHCPv4 component and clearing interface parameters.

methods.name: amxd_status_t dhcp4_layer(mode_ctrl_t mode,amxc_var_t * const parameters,bool enable)
methods.description: Controls DHCPv4 layer's enable or disable state, calling internal functions accordingly.

methods.name: amxd_status_t dhcpc6_enable(UNUSED mode_ctrl_t mode,const amxc_var_t * const parameters)
methods.description: Enables DHCPv6 client on specified interface, setting interface parameters, enabling neighbor discovery if applicable.

methods.name: amxd_status_t dhcpc6_disable(UNUSED mode_ctrl_t mode,const amxc_var_t * const parameters)
methods.description: Disables DHCPv6 client on specified interface, disabling neighbor discovery and clearing interface parameters.

methods.name: amxd_status_t dhcp6_layer(UNUSED mode_ctrl_t mode,amxc_var_t * const parameters,bool enable)
methods.description: Controls DHCPv6 layer's enable or disable state, invoking internal functions accordingly.
